Run compliance scans and generate audit-ready reports.

Frameworks:
  pci_dss_v4.0   PCI DSS v4.0 (12 requirements)
  pci_dss_v3.2.1 PCI DSS v3.2.1
  hipaa          HIPAA Security Rule
  gdpr           GDPR
  nist_sp_800-53 NIST SP 800-53 Rev.5
  iso_27001-2013 ISO 27001:2013
  soc_2          SOC 2
  cis_csc_v8     CIS Critical Security Controls v8

Examples:
  trace compliance report --framework pci_dss_v4.0
  trace compliance assess --framework pci_dss_v4.0 --control 1.2.5 --status pass
  trace compliance evidence --framework hipaa --control 164.312 --file audit-log.txt
  trace compliance frameworks

Usage:
  trace compliance [flags]
  trace compliance [command]

Available Commands:
  assess      Manually assess a compliance control (pass/fail/na)
  evidence    Attach evidence to a compliance control
  frameworks  List available compliance frameworks
  report      Generate a compliance report for a framework
  trend       Show compliance score history over time

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for compliance

Global Flags:
  -c, --config string   path to config file

Use "trace compliance [command] --help" for more information about a command.
